mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_inspect_llm_usage (fp_id, scene, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_estimate, elapsed_ms, success, error_msg) VALUES (#{fpId}, #{scene}, #{model}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{costEstimate}, #{elapsedMs}, #{success}, #{errorMsg})
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) AS day, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(input_tokens) AS inputTokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS outputTokens, SUM(cost_estimate) AS cost FROM ai_inspect_llm_usage WHERE create_time >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY day DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(IF(success = 0, 1, 0)) AS failed FROM ai_inspect_llm_usage WHERE create_time >= #{since}

SELECT scene, model, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(IF(success = 0, 1, 0)) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cost_estimate), 0) AS cost FROM ai_inspect_llm_usage WHERE create_time >= #{from} AND create_time < #{to} GROUP BY scene, model
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens FROM ai_inspect_llm_usage WHERE fp_id = #{fpId} AND create_time >= #{since}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_inspect_llm_usage WHERE create_time < #{before} LIMIT 10000
